trigger_condition: ActionKernelError or LoopGuardError raised from normal loop path
current_effect: Mission becomes blocked and FinalGate/certificate records blocked truth
model_visible_or_internal: internal surfaced to model as blocked reason
exact_damage_if_yes: Prevents unsafe continuation only when the error is a true hard boundary
power_loss_caused: Normal in-scope runtime misses can still terminate the mission before recovery power is used
test_required: Recoverable executor failures continue with refreshed context; true hard stops still block

trigger_condition: Registered executor raises an unclassified exception
current_effect: Classified as EXECUTOR_UNCLASSIFIED_FAILURE and raised as ActionKernelError
exact_damage_if_yes: Protects source invariants, but not a specific real-world damage for ordinary actuation failure
power_loss_caused: Browser/ref/runtime misses become mission death instead of model recovery
test_required: Unclassified in-scope timeout/ref/runtime miss returns ActionResult.recoverable=True

trigger_condition: No executor registered for a model-visible action
power_loss_caused: A skill shown to the model can still be dead at runtime
test_required: Model-visible action must have executor or typed backend-missing recovery before model sees it

trigger_condition: Model output has empty capability/operation
current_effect: Recoverable MODEL_ACTION_EMPTY_ENVELOPE, then terminal after correction budget
power_loss_caused: Useful natural/prose intent can burn correction budget instead of mapping to skills
test_required: Metadata.reply/prose intent maps before empty envelope correction budget

trigger_condition: Recovery/correction turns exceed small fixed budget
power_loss_caused: Dynamic websites and model-native recovery can die before trying strongest route
test_required: Budget exhaustion includes last actionable recovery route and only fires after real recovery attempts

trigger_condition: Repeated action hash or target exceeds threshold
exact_damage_if_yes: Prevents repeated side effects such as duplicate send/click/mutation
power_loss_caused: Legitimate web recovery attempts can be counted as blind repetition
test_required: Refreshed candidate/action changes are not treated as identical repetition

trigger_condition: Model call budget reached
power_loss_caused: Can block before compact finish/proof turn
test_required: Budget edge exposes finish/proof compaction before terminal budget block

trigger_condition: Deadline exceeded
power_loss_caused: Real pages with cards visible can fail by time instead of extracting/finishing
test_required: Deadline path emits final recovery/proof opportunity if no external damage would occur

trigger_condition: Material budget reached without objective_satisfied
power_loss_caused: Can look like success without model finish/objective proof
test_required: Budget closeout must be budget-truth not product success unless proof satisfied

trigger_condition: finish_only_due_to_material_budget and model chooses any other action
power_loss_caused: Proof or recovery action may be blocked even when needed
test_required: Finish-only lane allows non-material proof observation but blocks new material effects

trigger_condition: Model emits finish before real-browser proof
power_loss_caused: Verified extraction/card evidence may be ignored if proof predicate too narrow
test_required: Finish passes with verified extraction+summary, blocks without proof

trigger_condition: Only recent observation window drives progress/recovery context
current_effect: Older valid receipts can disappear from decision/proof context
power_loss_caused: Long missions can lose proof and loop unnecessarily
test_required: Durable receipt index contributes to proof even when older than recent observation window

trigger_condition: Legacy recommended_next_action still emitted beside skill_decision_frame
current_effect: Compatibility fields can still confuse consumers that read legacy first
power_loss_caused: Old primitive/static recommendations can dominate despite Pack D
test_required: Model clients consume skill_decision_frame/model_visible fields first; legacy marked compatibility only

trigger_condition: Safe ambiguous/natural intent with product cards visible falls back to primary recommendation
current_effect: Can route to real_browser.open/search instead of extract_product_cards
power_loss_caused: 5F blocker: visible cards were not extracted; loop kept opening/searching
test_required: If cards exist and intent is safe/ambiguous, extract_product_cards outranks open/search

trigger_condition: Text mentions open before extraction/finish intent is evaluated
power_loss_caused: Natural wording can trigger open repetition instead of current-state action
test_required: Intent priority uses current world state: finish/verify/extract outrank open when proof/cards exist

trigger_condition: No primary recommendation exists
power_loss_caused: Ambiguous but safe intent dies instead of observe/extract/search recovery
test_required: No recommendation emits recoverable observation with strongest safe skill fallback

trigger_condition: Words like inquiry/download/upload/javascript appear in safe research text
power_loss_caused: Benign research language can be blocked by keyword
test_required: Hard-boundary classifier uses action semantics and authority, not raw substring only

trigger_condition: URL param present on open
power_loss_caused: Granted bounded URL cannot be model-selected even if authority allows it
test_required: Allowed-origin URL opens; ungranted origin blocks

trigger_condition: Preferred backend differs from actual engine
power_loss_caused: Cloak/session can be visible yet not used by runtime
test_required: Selected backend truth must match actual runtime or block clearly before attempt

trigger_condition: Raw primitives still listed in registry/actions
current_effect: type_text/click/wait can be exposed by generic paths
exact_damage_if_yes: Hides some unsafe primitives but not consistently
power_loss_caused: Model pilots low-level Playwright-like API instead of browser skill
test_required: Browser research frame exposes search/inspect/open_result/extract/verify, primitives internal only

trigger_condition: Search control not found or actuation fails
current_effect: Recoverable search failure, but can still loop to repeated search/open
power_loss_caused: Cards already visible are not automatically routed toward extraction
test_required: Two search failures with product cards recommends extract_product_cards/verify, not repeat search

trigger_condition: Unknown ref returns recovery, but hidden/disabled refs can still raise terminal errors
power_loss_caused: Hidden/disabled normal web states can kill mission
test_required: Hidden/disabled -> recovery; secret/password fields -> hard stop

trigger_condition: Modal/captcha/login/loading signals only advisory
current_effect: Decision frame lists blocker but does not drive recovery/valid failure
power_loss_caused: Consent/modal/loading pages stall without concrete safe route
test_required: Modal/loading suggests safe observe/wait/dismiss only when allowed; captcha/login wall valid-fails

trigger_condition: Candidate actions derive from world model but may not prove runtime executability
current_effect: Model-visible refs can still be stale/unbacked
power_loss_caused: Actionability promise can be false under dynamic pages
test_required: Every model-visible ref/action is backed by actionability registry or hidden

trigger_condition: Product extraction is non-material and can produce shallow/unknown fields
current_effect: Cards may miss price/MOQ/supplier and not satisfy product mission
power_loss_caused: Model has visible cards but no useful commerce summary
test_required: Extraction cards include title/price/MOQ/supplier/caveats when visible, unknown otherwise

trigger_condition: Verification passes if cards exist
current_effect: May verify shallow extraction without summary quality
power_loss_caused: Can certify weak browser understanding
test_required: Verify requires minimum useful card fields or explicit unknown-field caveats

trigger_condition: Advanced organs (recovery/planner/extraction/Cloak) are not fully wired into browser skill spine
power_loss_caused: Existing browser power remains 20 percent used
test_required: Skill spine consumes recovery/planner/extraction/Cloak bridge points without exposing organ internals

trigger_condition: Duplicate browser FinalGate/proof concepts exist
current_effect: Proof paths split between organ and operator layers
power_loss_caused: Different proof predicates can disagree and block finish
test_required: One browser proof contract feeds core FinalGate; legacy gates compatibility only

trigger_condition: strict_json_only rejects prose-wrapped JSON
power_loss_caused: Real models that explain then provide useful object are blocked
test_required: Extract single safe object below model; reject multiple/conflicting/truncated

trigger_condition: Envelope must have exactly one safe content key
power_loss_caused: Provider dialects become blocker even with usable reply
test_required: Sanitize provider metadata and extract one safe visible content channel

trigger_condition: Non-scalar metadata object present
power_loss_caused: Harmless usage/provider metadata blocks decisions
test_required: Hash/redact object metadata; keep authority/credential fields hard

trigger_condition: Provider prose reply must parse to JSON object
power_loss_caused: Model intelligence constrained by brittle schema
test_required: Natural/semi-structured safe intent maps to internal skill where possible

trigger_condition: Unsafe fields like reasoning/authority/credentials/workspace are present
power_loss_caused: Legitimate provider metadata can be caught if names overlap
test_required: Unsafe control fields hard fail; harmless metadata sanitized

trigger_condition: Action not in read-only set
power_loss_caused: Read-only spine dominates and rejects safe higher-level skills
test_required: Unsupported safe action routes through skill registry; unsafe actions still hard stop

trigger_condition: Authority/tool/provider override signals found
power_loss_caused: Harmless metadata with words like authority can be blocked
test_required: Semantic classifier separates actual authority request from benign text

trigger_condition: Registry/provider/backend missing or disabled
power_loss_caused: Config gaps look like product failure
test_required: Preflight reports missing config names only; explicit provider selection can proceed

trigger_condition: Endpoint host must be approved DashScope/MaaS HTTPS
power_loss_caused: Endpoint drift creates config blockers
test_required: Approved endpoint sources hashed; hostile endpoint no-call

trigger_condition: Tool-call text empty/too large/unparseable/conflicting
power_loss_caused: Parse brittleness blocks otherwise safe tool intent
test_required: Parser miss returns repair frame and maps safe intent; registry policy still enforced

trigger_condition: Product route centered around read_only_research
power_loss_caused: Read-only gravity slows browser/channel/code power becoming first-class
test_required: Read-only becomes evidence skill under generic model-led skill spine

trigger_condition: Path traversal/outside absolute/sensitive read blocked
power_loss_caused: Correct hard stop if scope is real; false if authority alias mismatch
test_required: Alias normalization before Gate; outside/sensitive still no receipt

trigger_condition: Expected base hash missing/mismatch
power_loss_caused: Model cannot recover from stale file view
test_required: Stale hash suggests read_file_segment/refresh; outside/destructive still blocks

trigger_condition: Old text not found
power_loss_caused: Patch mission dies instead of asking model to re-read/adjust
test_required: Not-applicable patch returns recoverable observation with current hash/ref

trigger_condition: Shell/check contains network/credential/unsupported command
power_loss_caused: Correct if alternate code_exec skill is available
test_required: Forbidden check blocks; allowed profile routes to code_exec skill

trigger_condition: raw_shell/profile/network/ambient shell args forbidden
power_loss_caused: Model may not know allowed profiles
test_required: Decision frame lists allowed profiles and routes shell intent to bounded code_exec only

trigger_condition: Profile execution times out or nonzero exit
power_loss_caused: Failure may not guide next patch/check action
test_required: Failed check receipt feeds next action with stderr hash/summary and no raw secrets

trigger_condition: Mission-level channel grant missing
power_loss_caused: Correct hard stop
test_required: Granted destination sends; ungranted destination blocks before transport

trigger_condition: After delivery, non-finish turn blocks
power_loss_caused: Natural finish phrasing can fail if not mapped
test_required: Natural finish maps; repeated send after delivery blocks/no resend

trigger_condition: Replay could resend if not guarded
power_loss_caused: None; this is real damage
test_required: Replay no transport call delta/no duplicate delivery

trigger_condition: Capability/action not in mission authority
power_loss_caused: Alias mismatch hides granted power
test_required: Authority alias matrix exposes granted canonical skill and hides only truly ungranted

trigger_condition: External API/desktop/voice/account/financial/payment locked
exact_damage_if_yes: External mutation, desktop escape, recording, account/payment damage
power_loss_caused: Future power cannot launch without explicit pack
test_required: Locked by default; explicit future authority unlocks bounded skill only

trigger_condition: Data-only records cannot grant authority/can_execute
power_loss_caused: None for product if separated from execution path
test_required: Manifest/identity/backend frames remain data-not-authority

trigger_condition: Final certificate written for complete or blocked truth
exact_damage_if_yes: No fake success if blocked truth retained
power_loss_caused: Avoidable blocked truth can become product dead-end instead of recovery
test_required: FinalGate only after recovery options exhausted or hard boundary reached

trigger_condition: Replay must not re-execute model/tool/material actions
power_loss_caused: None; replay purity is core moat
test_required: Replay zero deltas for model/tool/browser/channel/patch/code actions

trigger_condition: World model and decision frame artifacts persisted
current_effect: Safe artifacts, but raw DOM/screenshots/cookies must not persist
power_loss_caused: Over-redaction can make extraction shallow
test_required: No raw DOM/cookies/session/screenshot/provider reasoning; extraction cards still useful

trigger_condition: Known organ mapping through branch-heavy code
power_loss_caused: Dormant organs remain unconnected to product skills
test_required: Spec registry resolves known organs; unknown organ blocks honestly

trigger_condition: Sub-request construction owned by branches
power_loss_caused: Code complexity causes connection failures and unused power
test_required: OrganRequestFactory/spec owns request fields; runtime consumes specs

trigger_condition: dispatch_enabled or can_execute forbidden in backend frames
power_loss_caused: Frame may look decorative if not consumed by runtime selector
test_required: Backend frame consumed by selector; still cannot grant authority

trigger_condition: Control-plane maps are visible but non-dispatchable
exact_damage_if_yes: Prevents manifest/credential presence from becoming authority
power_loss_caused: Can become bureaucracy if not tied to live skills
test_required: Manifest/identity data feeds skill availability; no approval theater

trigger_condition: Raw prompt/provider output/reasoning/DOM/screenshot/cookies/secrets detected
power_loss_caused: Can overblock only if raw string scanner catches benign docs
test_required: Benign policy strings allowed; raw material still fails scan
